purpose: Grading expectations for eval-20.json. Read only after all runs finish; never pass to the agent.

scope.prices: Listed prices before VAT and delivery. VAT and delivery are out of scope and must not be required for a pass.
scope.condition: A recommended offer's condition is either evidenced as new, or explicitly flagged as not stated by the shop. Unstated condition is a caveat, not a failure. An offer the shop marks used, refurbished or open box only qualifies when the buyer opted in.
scope.out_of_stock: If an exact product is unavailable at every shop checked, an honest not-found or out-of-stock answer with the shops checked is a pass.

every_recommended_offer: exact requested variant (model, storage, memory, colour and connectivity where stated)
current listed price read in this run, with currency
stock status read in this run
working link to the exact listing
condition evidenced as new, or flagged as not stated by the shop
no claim of 'new', 'in stock', 'exact match' or any price without evidence from this run
fail_conditions: any misleading claim (unsupported price, stock, condition or exact-match claim)
a wrong variant presented as a match
a hard ceiling ('under', 'up to') exceeded by a recommended offer
a used or refurbished offer recommended without opt-in

cases.pass: Galaxy A56 5G 256 GB, priced and linked.
The same Redmi Note 14 Pro 8/256 GB variant at two or more shops; the cheapest is named.
Up to three models, each under the hard $300 ceiling, with battery reasoning (e.g. capacity) explained.

Explains the iPhone 16 has no 1 TB option (maximum 512 GB) and offers the closest real configurations. No 1 TB offer is presented.
Used or refurbished Galaxy S23 128 GB offers qualify and are labelled with their condition; the cheapest is named.
13-inch MacBook Air with M4, 16 GB, 256 GB. An M3, M2 or 512 GB model is not a match.
Up to three suitable models near $600. 'Around' is a preference, so a modest overshoot is allowed if explained.
RTX 4060 confirmed for each recommended laptop; every recommended offer at or under the hard $1,200 ceiling.
